Of course, this ends up coming from people who played it long ago, and so they may be biased. While the graphics don't bug me at all, I'm more worried about how "user friendly" it is, as there are plenty of old RPGs that I liked when I was younger that are just a slog to get through because I'm spoiled on modern UI.

I'm a fan of the first two Paper Mario series, at the very least, but that's still not the same game, so.

I don't play many RPGs these days so I can't make a direct comparison -- but I'll say that the controls are definitely not a slog to get through. Square actually designed a very nice conflation of their old school RPG UI and something that would sate Mario action fans as well. "Timed hits," although I'm sure not exclusive to the game at that time, is something that instantly springs to mind.
